items.title: StyleSmuggler: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution (RCE)
items.summary: This zero-day vulnerability allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code on Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source servers by injecting malicious code into Magento's template system. It has been actively exploited in the wild, leading to backdoors and web shells.

items.title: Security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This regularly scheduled security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass. Adobe was not aware of any exploits in the wild for these specific issues at the time of release.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Unauthenticated Customer Account Takeover
items.summary: This critical vulnerability allows an unauthenticated attacker to switch a customer session to another customer account, gaining access to the victim's account and private data without user interaction or existing privileges. It has been added to CISA's KEV catalog due to active exploitation.

items.title: Security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This security update resolves multiple critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including security feature bypass, arbitrary code execution, and privilege escalation. It addresses seven vulnerabilities, five of which are rated critical.

items.title: Unauthenticated Arbitrary File Upload in Amasty Order Attributes
items.summary: This flaw in the Amasty Order Attributes extension allows unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files to a Magento store without logging in, potentially leading to remote code execution.
